PROFILE.TITLE: My profile
PROFILE.AVATAR_HINT: Add a profile picture to show next to your name throughout the app.
PROFILE.AVATAR_FORMAT_HINT: PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF, up to 3MB.
PROFILE.EMAIL_LOCKED_HINT: Email is used to sign in and can't be changed here - contact a superadmin.
PROFILE.PASSWORD_MISMATCH: New password and confirmation don't match.
PROFILE.NO_RESEARCHES: You aren't assigned to any research.
PROFILE.LEAVE_CONFIRM: Leave this research? You will lose access to its data.
PROFILE.LEAVE_ERROR_LAST: This is your only assigned research - you can't leave it without access to at least one other.

ACCEPT_INVITE.TITLE: Welcome
ACCEPT_INVITE.HINT: Set your password to access your account.
ACCEPT_INVITE.DONE_TEXT: Your password has been set. You can now sign in.
ACCEPT_INVITE.ERROR_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Contact a superadmin for a new invite.
ACCEPT_INVITE.ERROR_ALREADY_USED: This invite has already been used - the account is already active.

TEAM_INVITE.TITLE: Research invitation
TEAM_INVITE.HINT: Hi {{name}}, you've been invited to join the research "{{research}}". You won't see this research's data until you accept.
TEAM_INVITE.DONE_TEXT: Invitation accepted - you now have access to this research. Sign in to continue.
TEAM_INVITE.ERROR_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new invitation.
TEAM_INVITE.ERROR_ALREADY_ACCEPTED: This invitation has already been accepted - you already have access to this research.

CONFIGURATION.TITLE: Configuration
CONFIGURATION.TEAM_HINT: Researchers with access to this research. As an owner (OWNER), you can add an existing researcher from the directory or change/remove existing members.
CONFIGURATION.TEAM_REMOVE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to remove this researcher from the research?
CONFIGURATION.TEAM_WITHDRAW_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to withdraw this invitation?
CONFIGURATION.TEAM_INVITE_SENT: Invitation sent - access will be active once the researcher accepts it.
CONFIGURATION.TEAM_ERROR: Error - check whether you're trying to remove the research's last owner (OWNER).

STUDY_CONFIG.TITLE: Study configuration
STUDY_CONFIG.HINT: Instrument settings for the selected research - EEG device, NASA-TLX structure, and REI-40 questionnaire variant.
STUDY_CONFIG.EEG_NOT_APPLICABLE_HINT: EEG is only available for "Pull Request Review"-type research (Task Configuration) - change the task type to enable EEG.
STUDY_CONFIG.EEG_DEVICE_INSIGHT5_HINT: Supported format - recordings are automatically parsed and charted (composite indices, frequency bands, signal quality).
STUDY_CONFIG.EEG_DEVICE_OTHER_HINT: This device's format isn't parsed - the CSV file is only stored and downloadable, no automatic charts.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_TLX_HINT: When off, the "NASA-TLX" item is hidden from the Results menu for this research. The NASA-TLX app itself still runs independently of this setting.
STUDY_CONFIG.REI40_VARIANT_OPTION_SHORT: Short form (10 items, drawn from the REI-40 set)
STUDY_CONFIG.REI40_VARIANT_HINT: The short form uses a subset of 10 existing REI-40 items (not the official, unpublished REI-10) - see the docs for details on the item selection.
STUDY_CONFIG.REI40_VARIANT_LOCKED_HINT: Locked - at least one participant in this research has already completed the REI questionnaire, so the variant can no longer be changed.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_PSYCH_TESTS_LABEL: This research uses psychological tests (REI-40, Big Five)
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_PSYCH_TESTS_ON_HINT: After giving consent, a participant gets an email with links to both tests (as before).
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_PSYCH_TESTS_OFF_HINT: After giving consent, a participant does NOT get test links - instead they get a thank-you email, and researchers follow up with them directly.
STUDY_CONFIG.STUDY_DISPLAY_NAME_LABEL: Study display name (for the thank-you email)
STUDY_CONFIG.STUDY_DISPLAY_NAME_HINT: Shown in the thank-you email when psychological tests are turned off - the only editable part of that email.
STUDY_CONFIG.EMAIL_SENDER_NAME_HINT: Shown as the sender name on every participant-facing email (consent, new links, thank-you). The address itself never changes - only the displayed name. Falls back to the study display name above when left empty.
STUDY_CONFIG.EMAIL_SENDER_NAME_ERROR: Sender name can be at most 150 characters.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_DEMOGRAPHICS_LABEL: This research uses a demographic questionnaire
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_DEMOGRAPHICS_HINT: After giving consent, the participant gets a demographic questionnaire link in the same email as REI-40/Big Five (labeled "Demographic questionnaire", not a number in the sequence). Questions are configured on the "Demographic questions" page.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_CONSENT_FORM_LABEL: This research uses a Consent form
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_CONSENT_FORM_ON_HINT: A participant gives consent first (Consent app), then receives an email with links. The "Consent form" page is visible in the nav.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_CONSENT_FORM_OFF_HINT: No consent step - a participant just enters their ID and sees their links right away, with no consent text and no email. The "Consent form" page is removed from the nav.
STUDY_CONFIG.CONSENT_LANGUAGE_HINT: If only one language is checked, a participant never chooses at their first login - it's auto-locked to that language. With both checked, the participant picks as they do today.
STUDY_CONFIG.TRACKS_PARTICIPANTS_ON_HINT: The "Participants", "Import participants", and "Experimental sessions" pages are available in the nav.
STUDY_CONFIG.TRACKS_PARTICIPANTS_OFF_HINT: Those pages are removed from the nav - this research doesn't import or remember participant data as a structured list.
STUDY_CONFIG.TRACKS_PARTICIPANTS_FORCED_HINT: Always on for PR Review research - the code-review-ai flow requires tracked participants.
STUDY_CONFIG.TIMER_HINT: Optionally set a countdown for participants in every app this research uses - on expiry the app automatically submits whatever the participant currently has entered. Duration is configured independently per app.
STUDY_CONFIG.TIMER_NOT_APPLICABLE_HINT: This research doesn't currently use any app the timer can be configured for.
STUDY_CONFIG.USES_SHEETS_HINT: Switches on the "Tables" page: the template is built in a separate app and participants fill it in through a personal link. You review and export the results here.
STUDY_CONFIG.SHOW_BRANDING_LABEL: Show the BeyondAI logo and name to participants
STUDY_CONFIG.SHOW_BRANDING_HINT: When off, participants of this research see no BeyondAI logo or "BeyondAI Research Group" name in any app (nor in the browser tab), and emails carry "Empirical Software Engineering Platform" instead (or the sender name set above, if any) with no contact address in the footer. The admin dashboard is unchanged.

CALENDAR.TITLE: Calendar
CALENDAR.HINT: All experimental sessions on a month view - drag to reschedule, click to open.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HINT: Connect your Google account so every session you schedule (Experimental Sessions) automatically becomes an event on your Google Calendar, inviting the participant.
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HELP_ARIA: How do I connect Google Calendar?
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HELP_STEP2: Sign in with the Google account you want scheduled-session invites to go to.
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HELP_STEP3: On Google's screen, click "Allow" to grant calendar access.
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HELP_STEP4: You're brought back here - the status will show "Connected as ...", and from then on every session you assign becomes an event on your calendar.
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_HELP_NOTE: If you see "Access blocked" instead, your account hasn't been approved yet - ask the admin to add you as a test user.
SETTINGS.CALENDAR_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google Calendar integration hasn't been set up on the server yet (missing OAuth credentials) - contact the platform administrator.
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FORMS_HINT: Connect your Google account so the platform can read the structure (questions) of a Google Forms survey used by a research with task type "Google Forms" - without this you can still describe CSV columns manually.
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FORMS_HELP_STEP2: Sign in with the Google account that owns (or has access to) the Google Forms survey this research uses.
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FORMS_HELP_STEP3: On Google's screen, click "Allow" to grant read access to the form's structure.
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FORMS_HELP_STEP4: You're brought back here - the status will show "Connected as ...". On the Task Configuration page you can then click "Read form structure" to load the questions automatically instead of entering them by hand.
SETTINGS.GOOGLE_FORMS_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google Forms integration hasn't been set up on the server yet (missing OAuth credentials) - contact the platform administrator. Until then you can still describe columns manually on the Task Configuration page.

EXPERIMENTAL_SESSIONS.TITLE: Experimental sessions
EXPERIMENTAL_SESSIONS.HINT: Physical visits where participants are run - one date can cover several participants and several of their Intro/AI/Report sessions. Notes can be left both for the whole visit and for each participant's individual session within it.
EXPERIMENTAL_SESSIONS.ALREADY_ASSIGNED_ERROR: This session is already assigned to a different experimental session - unassign it there first.
EXPERIMENTAL_SESSIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this experimental session? Assigned participant sessions are kept (with their notes and tags) - they're just removed from this experimental session.

PARTICIPANTS.TITLE: Participants
PARTICIPANTS.EMPTY: No participants for the selected research.
PARTICIPANTS.NOT_SCHEDULED_WARNING: This session is finished but was never assigned to any experimental session.

IMPORT.TITLE: Import participants
IMPORT.HINT: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file for the selected research - a "Participants" sheet for new participants, a "Tasks" sheet for AI/Report session + PR assignment. The Intro session is added automatically. You can fill in just one sheet, or both in the same file.
IMPORT.HINT_SIMPLE: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) file with a "Participants" sheet: one row per participant (ParticipantId, and optionally Email, Language, Group, ResearchTask). Nothing else is needed for this research: no PRs and no session assignment, the steps are started from the protocol.
IMPORT.DROPZONE_TITLE: Drag an Excel file here or click to browse
IMPORT.PARSE_FAILED: Couldn't read the file. Check that it's a valid Excel (.xlsx) file.
IMPORT.PARSE_ERRORS_TITLE: Found {{count}} issues in the file - fix them and re-upload:

TASK_ERROR.TASK_NOT_FOUND: No task with that label has been added in this research.
TASK_ERROR.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That session doesn't exist for this participant.

IMPORT.GROUPS_UNKNOWN_TITLE: The group was not recognised for {{count}} participants (imported without a group):
IMPORT.GROUPS_NEXT_HINT: Participants without a group are assigned on the Participants page (by hand or at random).
IMPORT.PR_UNKNOWN_TITLE: The PR task was not recognised for {{count}} participants (imported without a task):
IMPORT.AUTO_HINT: The new names were put into groups and tasks. Check the assignment in the participant list and confirm it. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
IMPORT.AUTO_FAILED: The participants were imported, but the automatic assignment failed. Run it from the participant list.
IMPORT.RESEARCH_TASK_UNKNOWN: {{count}} tasks from the ResearchTask column do not exist in this research and were not assigned.

TASK_CONFIG.TITLE: Task configuration
TASK_CONFIG.HINT: Choose what kind of task this research's participants are centered on - the page layout changes based on your choice.
TASK_CONFIG.ERROR: Failed to save the task type. Please try again.
TASK_CONFIG.GOOGLE_FORMS_URL_HINT: The link is saved as a reference. If you connect your Google account (Configuration page), the platform can also read this form's questions - see "Form structure" below.
TASK_CONFIG.GOOGLE_FORMS_FILES_HINT: Upload the reports/results exported from the Google Forms responses (e.g. CSV or XLSX) - you can add several files and download them later as needed.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_FILES_HINT: Upload files related to this task - you can add several files and download them later as needed.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASKS_HINT: Define several distinct tasks (written instructions and/or a PDF, timer duration, allowed file types) and assign exactly one to each participant below. Participants receive their task through a personal link in a dedicated app, with a countdown and a solution upload.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASK_CONTENT_REQUIRED: Enter written instructions and/or upload a PDF.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASK_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this task? Participants it's assigned to will be left without a task.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_ASSIGNMENT_HINT: Pick exactly one task from the list above for each participant - the change saves immediately.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_ASSIGNMENT_EMPTY: No participants for the selected research.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASK_TIMER_HINT: How many minutes the participant has to work on the task in the task app - on expiry, whatever's been uploaded so far is submitted automatically.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASK_TIMER_INVALID: Duration must be a number between 1 and 180 minutes.
TASK_CONFIG.GENERIC_TASK_FILE_TYPES_HINT: If nothing is checked, the participant can upload any file type.

FORM_STRUCTURE.HEADING: Form structure
FORM_STRUCTURE.HINT: Describe what each column in the CSV results means - used for the descriptive statistics below. You can read them automatically (if you've connected a Google account) or enter them by hand.
FORM_STRUCTURE.HELP_STEP1: Automatic read (optional): go to the Configuration page → Google Forms section and connect your Google account with the "Connect Google account" button.
FORM_STRUCTURE.HELP_STEP2: Save the link to the Google Forms survey in the "Google Forms URL" field at the top of this page.
FORM_STRUCTURE.HELP_STEP3: Come back here and click "Read form structure" - the questions load automatically from the survey and appear below, labeled "Google Forms".
FORM_STRUCTURE.HELP_STEP4: Manual entry (always available, with or without a connected account): click "+ Add column", then for each CSV column enter its exact source question text (same as the column name in the CSV) and a type (Number / Text / Likert scale / Choice).
FORM_STRUCTURE.HELP_STEP5: Rows can still be edited freely after an automatic read - changes are only saved once you click "Save".
FORM_STRUCTURE.NOT_CONNECTED_HINT: You haven't connected a Google account (Configuration page) - you can still describe columns manually below.
FORM_STRUCTURE.READ_ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED: You haven't connected a Google account.
FORM_STRUCTURE.READ_ERROR_NO_FORM_URL: First save a valid Google Forms link above.
FORM_STRUCTURE.READ_ERROR_FORMS_API_ERROR: Error reading the form - check that the connected account has access to this form.
FORM_STRUCTURE.READ_ERROR_SERVER_ERROR: Error reading the form. Please try again.
FORM_STRUCTURE.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Original question text from the survey (same as the column name in the CSV)
FORM_STRUCTURE.ID_COLUMN_HINT: Mark which column in the CSV results corresponds to the participant's ID (the same ID they were imported with) - this links every survey row to a specific participant.
FORM_STRUCTURE.NEEDS_URL_HINT: Form structure appears once you've saved a Google Forms link in the field above.

DESCRIPTIVE_STATS.HEADING: Descriptive statistics
DESCRIPTIVE_STATS.HINT: Automatically computed from the most recently uploaded CSV file - no R script needed.
DESCRIPTIVE_STATS.NEEDS_FILE_HINT: Descriptive statistics appear once you've uploaded at least one results file above.
DESCRIPTIVE_STATS.NO_CSV: No CSV results file has been uploaded yet.
DESCRIPTIVE_STATS.PARTICIPANT_MATCH: {{matched}} of {{total}} participants have responded to the survey.

TASK_CONFIG.FROM_PROTOCOL_HINT: The kind of task is chosen in the "Experimental session" step of the protocol. Here you set up the task itself.

TASK_FILES.REJECT_FORM_MISMATCH: The file's columns don't match the form structure ({{matched}}/{{total}} questions found) - check that this is the right survey.
TASK_FILES.REJECT_CSV_PARSE_ERROR: The file couldn't be read as CSV.

R_ANALYSIS.HINT: Optional: upload an R script that will run against the uploaded survey results, in a sandboxed environment, and produce plots and an interpreted results summary.
R_ANALYSIS.UPLOAD_ERROR: Failed to upload the script. Please try again.
R_ANALYSIS.EDITOR_HINT: An uploaded script is automatically loaded here for editing. "Run" always executes whatever's currently in the editor (even if you haven't uploaded a file yet - you can write a script directly here).
R_ANALYSIS.CONVENTION_HINT: The script should write plots to /output/*.png and a text results summary to /output/results.txt. The script has no internet access - only pre-installed R packages are available.
R_ANALYSIS.ERROR_ALREADY_RUNNING: An analysis is already running for this research.
R_ANALYSIS.ERROR_SERVER: Failed to start the analysis. Please try again.
R_ANALYSIS.NO_RESULTS_TEXT: The script didn't write a text summary (/output/results.txt).
R_ANALYSIS.EXPORT_LATEST_ERROR: Failed to export results. Try again.

GENERIC_TASK_RESULTS.EMPTY: No tasks have been submitted yet.
GENERIC_TASK_RESULTS.EXPORT_ZIP_ERROR: Failed to download the archive. Try again.

PR_CONFIG.TITLE: PR configuration
PR_CONFIG.HINT: Add any number of PR tasks for this research. Each task has its own short label - those labels are what the researcher picks from in the Excel participant-import template. Optionally, one task can be flagged as the Intro task - that PR opens automatically in every Intro session, with no need to name it in the spreadsheet.
PR_CONFIG.IS_INTRO_LABEL: This is the Intro task (opens in every Intro session)
PR_CONFIG.TOKEN_HINT: The token is never remembered or re-displayed - every new PR needs its own token.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_LINK_ARIA: Where do I get the GitHub owner and repository?
PR_CONFIG.HELP_LINK_STEP1: Open the repository on GitHub - the browser address looks like this: github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_LINK_STEP2: "Owner" is the segment right after github.com/ - the organization or username.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_LINK_STEP3: "Repository" is the next segment - the repository's own name.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_PR_NUMBER_ARIA: Where do I find the PR number?
PR_CONFIG.HELP_PR_NUMBER_STEP1: Open the specific Pull Request on GitHub - the address looks like this: .../pull/42.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_PR_NUMBER_STEP2: The number after "/pull/" is the PR number - in this example, that's 42.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_ARIA: How do I create a GitHub Personal Access Token?
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_TITLE: How to create a GitHub Personal Access Token
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_STEP1: Go to github.com/settings/tokens (signed in to the GitHub account that has access to the repository).
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_STEP3: Select the "repo" scope (needed to read pull requests).
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_STEP4: Copy the token immediately - GitHub only shows it once.
PR_CONFIG.HELP_TOKEN_NOTE: The token is never remembered or shown again after saving - if you lose it, you'll need to create a new one.
PR_CONFIG.ERROR: Save failed. The label may already be taken, or try again.
PR_CONFIG.EMPTY: No PR tasks added for this research yet.
PR_CONFIG.LABEL_ERROR: Error - the label may already be taken.
PR_CONFIG.DELETE_ERROR_IN_USE: Can't delete - assigned to a participant.

RESEARCHES.TITLE: Researches
RESEARCHES.HINT: Manage the study's university researches - add a new one or edit an existing one.
RESEARCHES.NEW_PROTOCOL_HINT: A new research starts empty. You define its protocol (the steps of the research) on the Protocol page right after adding it, and you can change it freely while it has no participants.
RESEARCHES.NEW_WIZARD_HINT: A new research is created step by step: basics, type of study, variables, groups and protocol steps.

DEMOGRAPHIC_QUESTIONS.TITLE: Demographic questions
DEMOGRAPHIC_QUESTIONS.HINT: Edit the demographic questionnaire's questions for the selected research - add, remove, or reorder questions and options by dragging, and enter text in both languages. For an "Other" option, turn on the "Text field" switch so participants can type their answer.
DEMOGRAPHIC_QUESTIONS.ANSWERED_CONFLICT: Cannot save: a question or option that participants have already answered cannot be deleted or have its type changed. Edit only the text, or leave it as is.
DEMOGRAPHIC_QUESTIONS.OTHER_SPECIFY_HINT: Turn on for an "Other" option: when a participant picks it, a field appears where they type their answer.

CONSENT_FORM.TITLE: Consent form
CONSENT_FORM.HINT: Edit the informed consent form's sections for the selected research - add, remove, or drag to reorder sections, and edit each one's text in both languages.
CONSENT_FORM.LOAD_ERROR: Failed to load the form. Please try again.
CONSENT_FORM.DELIVERY_HINT: Two ways for participants to reach the consent form: share the same public link with everyone, or upload a list to send personalized links by email.
CONSENT_FORM.DELIVERY_LINK_HINT: A dedicated link for this research - the same for every one of its participants, who type their own ID once they open it. Share it however you like (email, a flyer on campus, etc.).
CONSENT_FORM.DELIVERY_SLUG_ERROR_INVALID_SLUG: The path may only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes.
CONSENT_FORM.DELIVERY_SLUG_ERROR_SLUG_TAKEN: This path is already taken - try another one.

RESEARCHERS.NEW_INVITES_SENT: Sent {{n}} invitation(s) to join the research/researches - access will be active once the researcher accepts.
RESEARCHERS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this researcher? This action cannot be undone.
RESEARCHERS.DELETE_ERROR_LAST_SUPERADMIN: Cannot delete the last remaining superadmin.
RESEARCHERS.EXISTING_HINT: Pick an already-existing researcher and assign them (additionally) to a research - no new invite is sent.

PROTOCOL.TITLE: Protocol
PROTOCOL.HINT: Define the steps participants go through and their order. A step is emailed to the participant as soon as the previous one is completed (or later, if you set a delay).
PROTOCOL.PARTICIPANT_BLIND_NOTE: Participants do not see the protocol or the list of steps: they only receive a link to their next step. You see each participant's progress in the participant overview.
PROTOCOL.NOT_PROTOCOL: This research uses the classic flow, so it has no protocol. Only researches created in "Own protocol" mode have one.
PROTOCOL.EMPTY: The protocol is empty. Add the first step.
PROTOCOL.LOCKED: This step is locked because participants have already started it.
PROTOCOL.STARTED_NOTE: Locked: {{count}} participant(s) already have progress on this step.
PROTOCOL.DELIVERY_HINT_AUTO: Sent as soon as the participant completes the previous step (first step: as soon as you start the protocol).
PROTOCOL.DELIVERY_HINT_AFTER_DELAY: Sent the given number of days after the previous step was completed.
PROTOCOL.DELIVERY_HINT_MANUAL: Sent only when you trigger it from the participant overview.
PROTOCOL.ORDER_FROZEN_HINT: The order of the steps up to the last step participants have started cannot be changed. You can add new steps at the end.
PROTOCOL.ERR_TITLE: Every step needs a name in both languages.
PROTOCOL.ERR_QUESTIONNAIRE: Choose a questionnaire for every "Questionnaire" step.
PROTOCOL.ERR_URL: Enter a valid address (starting with http:// or https://).
PROTOCOL.ERR_MESSAGE: The message needs text in both languages.
PROTOCOL.ERR_DELAY: The number of days must be a whole number from 0 to 365.
PROTOCOL.ERR_ORDER_FROZEN: Cannot save: you changed the order of steps participants have already started.
PROTOCOL.ERR_STEP_HAS_PROGRESS: Cannot save: you cannot remove or retype a step participants already have progress on.
PROTOCOL.ERR_DUPLICATE: This step can appear only once in a protocol:
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_CONSENT: The participant reads and accepts the consent form. You edit its content on the Consent form page.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_DEMOGRAPHIC: The demographic questionnaire. You edit its questions on the Demographic questionnaire page.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_QUESTIONNAIRE: Your own questionnaire, built on the Questionnaires page.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_REI40: The validated questionnaire on rational and experiential thinking style (fixed items).
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_BIGFIVE: The Big Five personality questionnaire (fixed items).
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_EXTERNAL_LINK: The participant gets a link to an external page (e.g. Google Forms) and confirms they are done.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_MESSAGE: Just a message emailed to the participant (e.g. a thank-you or instructions). Nothing to fill in.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_MANUAL: A step done in person (e.g. EEG recording). You mark it as done manually; the participant receives nothing.
PROTOCOL.TYPE_HINT_EXPERIMENT: The main task of the study. You describe what participants will do and pick the kind of task. The participant gets an email with a link, and the step is done when they submit the task.

TASK_KIND_HINT.GENERIC_TASK: Each participant has their own task with instructions, a timer and file submission. You create the tasks on the Task configuration page.
TASK_KIND_HINT.GOOGLE_FORM: The participant opens your Google Form and confirms they filled it in. You enter the address on the Task configuration page.
TASK_KIND_HINT.SHEETS: The participant first reads the rules, then fills in the table you built in the sheets app. Superadmin only.
TASK_KIND_HINT.CODE_REVIEW: The participant reviews a pull request with an AI assistant or documentation. You enter the tasks (PRs) on the Task configuration page, and assign one to each participant in the import or in the participant list.
TASK_KIND_HINT.OTHER: A task with no ready-made module. You describe it in words in the "Extra text in the email" field below, the participant gets an email without a link, and you mark the step done by hand in the participant list.

PROTOCOL.EXPERIMENT_DESCRIPTION_HINT: Write what participants do in this session in the "Extra text in the email" field below. The participant reads it together with the link.
PROTOCOL.ERR_TASK_KIND: Choose a kind of task for the experimental session.
PROTOCOL.ERR_SUPERADMIN_ONLY: Only a superadmin can choose Table or Code Review.

REVIEW_MODE_HINT.AI: The participant talks to an AI assistant about the pull request.
REVIEW_MODE_HINT.REPORT: The participant reads prepared documentation, with no AI chat.
REVIEW_MODE_HINT.HYBRID: The participant has documentation in sections and can open an AI chat. Section openings are recorded.

PROTOCOL.OPEN_IMMEDIATELY: Open right after the table is handed in
PROTOCOL.OPEN_IMMEDIATELY_HINT: When the participant clicks "Finish and submit", this questionnaire opens at once, without an e-mail. If they close the page before filling it in, you can send it again from the participant list.
PROTOCOL.ERR_OPEN_IMMEDIATELY: "Open right away" only works for a questionnaire that comes right after the Sheets task and is sent automatically.
PROTOCOL.REVIEW_INCLUDE_INTRO: An Intro (practice) session before the main one
PROTOCOL.REVIEW_INTRO_HINT: When on, the participant first reviews the intro PR (the one marked as intro on the Task configuration page) and then the main one. They choose the mode themselves on the intro screen.
PROTOCOL.REVIEW_TLX_HINT: After the decision the participant automatically does NASA-TLX and a short session questionnaire. The step is done when they finish, so do not add a separate NASA-TLX step to the same protocol.
PROTOCOL.ERR_REVIEW_MODE: Choose a default review mode for the Code Review step.
PROTOCOL.ERR_OTHER_DESCRIPTION: For an "Other" task, write the description in the email text field in both languages.

QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_DELETE_ANSWERED: This questionnaire has responses and cannot be deleted.

QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_TITLE: The questionnaire needs a title in both languages.
QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_PROMPT: Every item needs text in both languages.
QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_SCALE: Scale points must be a whole number from 2 to 10.
QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_OPTION: Every option needs text in both languages.
QUESTIONNAIRES.ERR_ANSWERED: Cannot save: this questionnaire has been answered, so items and options cannot be deleted and an item's type or the scale points cannot change.

RESEARCH_DESIGN.TITLE: Research design
RESEARCH_DESIGN.HINT: What kind of study this is, which variables it has and whether participants are split into groups. Every field is optional. This is your methodological frame, participants never see it.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.NOT_PROTOCOL: A research design exists only for researches with a protocol.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.LOAD_ERROR: The research design could not be loaded.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_DUPLICATE_GROUP_NAME: Two groups cannot have the same name.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_GROUP_HAS_PARTICIPANTS: A group that already has participants cannot be deleted.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_INSUFFICIENT_ROLE: You are not allowed to change this research.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_SERVER_ERROR: Saving failed. Check your input and try again.

APPROACH_HINT.EXPERIMENTAL: The researcher changes the conditions (manipulates the independent variable) and assigns participants to them at random.
APPROACH_HINT.QUASI_EXPERIMENTAL: Conditions are compared, but participants are not randomly assigned (for example pre-existing groups).
APPROACH_HINT.CORRELATIONAL: The relationship between variables is measured without any manipulation.
APPROACH_HINT.DESCRIPTIVE: The state of the sample is described (survey, observation) without comparing conditions.

SUBJECT_HINT.BETWEEN: Each participant is in one condition, and conditions are compared across different groups of participants.
SUBJECT_HINT.WITHIN: The same participants go through all conditions or time points.
SUBJECT_HINT.MIXED: At least one factor is between-subjects and at least one is within-subjects.
SUBJECT_HINT.SINGLE_GROUP: All participants form one group, with no group comparison.

TIME_HINT.PRE_POST: Measured before and after an intervention.
TIME_HINT.REPEATED: The same measurement is repeated at several time points.
TIME_HINT.CROSSOVER: Each participant goes through all conditions, with a balanced order of conditions.

RESEARCH_DESIGN.VAR_HINT: Optional. You can skip this step. Variables are a record of your research plan.

VAR_ROLE_HINT.INDEPENDENT: What the researcher changes, or what the groups differ by.
VAR_ROLE_HINT.CONTROL: What is held constant so it cannot affect the outcome.
VAR_ROLE_HINT.MODERATOR: Changes the strength or direction of the relationship between the independent and dependent variable.
VAR_ROLE_HINT.MEDIATOR: Explains the mechanism through which the independent variable affects the dependent one.
VAR_ROLE_HINT.COVARIATE: A measured characteristic that is controlled for statistically.

RESEARCH_DESIGN.VAR_MEASUREMENT: How it is measured or manipulated (optional)
RESEARCH_DESIGN.GROUP_HINT: The protocol is the same for every group. A group is a label on the participant that shows up in the list, the results and the exports, so you can compare groups in your analysis.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ASSIGN_MODE: How participants are put into groups
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ASSIGN_HINT_MANUAL: You enter the group in the Group column when importing, or pick it in the participant list.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ASSIGN_HINT_RANDOM: On import the new participants are put into groups by themselves, and inside each group into tasks. The groups are filled evenly, and the draw is stored with its seed, so it can be reproduced. You see the result in the participant list before anything is sent.

WARN.NO_IV: An experimental study usually has at least one independent variable.
WARN.EXPERIMENTAL_RANDOM: An experiment usually assigns participants to groups at random. Consider "The platform, at random".
WARN.QUASI_RANDOM: A quasi-experiment, by definition, has no random assignment of participants to groups.
WARN.GROUPS_NEEDED: A between-subjects or mixed design needs at least two groups.
WARN.GROUPS_NOT_USED: Correlational and descriptive studies usually have no condition groups.
WARN.WITHIN_GROUPS: In a within-subjects design groups can stand for the order of conditions, but the protocol steps are the same for everyone.
WARN.NO_COUNTERBALANCING: The platform does not counterbalance the order of conditions on its own yet.
WARN.ONE_TASK: One task splits nobody. Add another one or remove this one.

RESEARCH_DESIGN.TASK_HINT: A task is a second factor next to the groups (e.g. Task A and Task B). When the platform assigns participants at random, every group is split evenly between the tasks. Leave empty if everybody does the same.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.TASK_REMOVE_BLOCKED: The task is already assigned to participants.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_DUPLICATE_TASK_NAME: Two tasks cannot have the same name.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_TASK_HAS_PARTICIPANTS: A task already assigned to participants cannot be deleted.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_GROUP_HAS_TEMPLATES: There is a table template for this group. Delete the template first.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_TASK_HAS_TEMPLATES: There is a table template for this task. Delete the template first.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_EMPTY_GROUP_NAME: A group has no name. Enter a name or remove the empty row.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_EMPTY_TASK_NAME: A task has no name. Enter a name or remove the empty row.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_EMPTY_VARIABLE_NAME: A variable has no name. Enter a name or remove the empty row.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.TASK_PDF_HINT: The written task as a PDF. The participant reads it on the introduction page, before working, and can open it again while working (up to 25 MB).
RESEARCH_DESIGN.TASK_PDF_SAVE_FIRST: Save the design first, then add the PDF (the task has to be saved before it can have a file).
RESEARCH_DESIGN.TASK_PDF_REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this PDF from the task?
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_NOT_A_PDF: The selected file is not a PDF.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_PDF_TOO_LARGE: The PDF is larger than 25 MB.
RESEARCH_DESIGN.ERR_PDF_UPLOAD: The PDF could not be saved or opened. Try again.

STUDY_WIZARD.GROUPS_OPTIONAL_HINT: Groups are usually not needed for this type of study. You can add them if you need them.
